description: Read-only reference checking over a markdown document: op names and their named flags against the live registry, paths, line numbers and section headings against the tree, and issues cited under an "Open defects" heading against the tracker. Checks references, never reasoning — a sentence asserting a gap is not a reference (#1220).

claims.description: Does this doc's references still hold? Three states — holds / contradicted / couldn't check — and the third never renders as clean. Verifies: backticked op tokens against the op registry (key= flags only; a head that resolves to nothing is unchecked, not a finding), paths and :LINE numbers and section headings against the repo, and every issue cited under an 'Open defects' heading against the tracker. Prose claims are not checked and the footer says so. Fenced code is skipped.
